profile_text.body:
Credo AI, founded in 2020, describes itself as the trusted leader in AI governance. The company's platform enables enterprises to discover AI systems, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. According to its website, Credo AI created the AI governance category and is now defining it for the agentic era, offering model-level, application-level, and agent-level governance in a single platform.

The company's core product, Credo AI, is a purpose-built AI governance platform powered by a Knowledge Graph that fuses global regulatory intelligence with business context. It includes ready-to-deploy policy packs for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001, with native integrations across existing enterprise stacks. The platform features GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), designed to compress weeks of governance work into hours through pre-built policy packs, automated workflows, and audit-ready evidence.

Credo AI's approach emphasizes contextual, continuous, and comprehensive AI governance without bolting AI features onto existing GRC tools. The company's policy packs are written by experts involved in standards development at ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD. Testimonials on the company's website reference deployments at organizations including Mastercard and IBM, with claims of accelerating EU AI Act compliance by 10 times over manual approaches.
